scope: All four M18 starts; all 480 scheduled training endpoints including repeats/noops; per-family mean K and R gradients plus actual scheduled natural K. Aggregate uses exact equal natural/task update weighting and frozen lambda. Euclidean raw parameter gradients at initial states, not Adam-preconditioned directions or finite-step outcomes. No fitting, no evaluation selection, no capacity impossibility claim.
stopping: One full compatibility map and independent Gram/aggregation audit; no optimizer grid.
